caption: A balloon pump is worked up and down with a limp balloon fitted over its nozzle, and the balloon swells until it is round and taut.

sa.check: A limp balloon is fitted over the nozzle of a balloon pump.
The pump is worked up and down.
The balloon is limp at the start.
The pumping comes first and the swelling follows.

pc.expect: The balloon grows a little with each stroke and not between strokes, and it does not shrink while pumping.
pc.fail: It inflates instantly; or shrinks while pumping continues; or grows between strokes with the pump still.

pc.expect: It stays one balloon on the nozzle and gets rounder.
pc.fail: It slips off the nozzle and keeps inflating; or splits into two; or turns into another shape.
It grows with no hands on the pump; or keeps growing after pumping stops; or deflates and reinflates on its own.

pc.expect: The rubber stretches smoothly and thins, and the pump body stays rigid.
pc.fail: The balloon stays wrinkled while large; or the pump bends; or the balloon is rigid.

pc.expect: One balloon and one pump keep their number.
pc.fail: The balloon duplicates; or the pump vanishes; or the balloon passes through the nozzle.

pc.expect: The balloon's colour and the pump stay the same.
pc.fail: The balloon changes colour; or the pump changes; or the background rearranges.
